theorem.name: FULL_DYNAMIC_COMPONENT_QUOTIENT_INDUCED_PATH_LIFT_V1
theorem.statement: For every k>=1, every induced P_k in Q_ALL lifts to an induced P_k in G by replacing each quotient component node [C] by an arbitrary representative z_C in C.

proof.map: u in U maps to itself; [C] maps to arbitrary z_C in C
consecutive: dynamic-dynamic adjacency is copied exactly from G[U]
dynamic-component adjacency means u complete to C, hence u-z_C is an edge
nonconsecutive: dynamic-component nonadjacency means u is not complete to C; by axiom (iv)+connectedness of C, u is anticomplete to C, hence u-z_C is a nonedge
different component nodes correspond to distinct connected components of G[Y0], hence their representatives are nonadjacent
proof.conclusion: All and only consecutive image pairs are adjacent.

theorem.corollary: If G is P7-free, Q_ALL is P7-free.
theorem.strengthening_over_old_seal: The proof uses no fixed coarse class sigma and no equality of list/type/support coordinates; it applies simultaneously to all still-dynamic vertices U.

all_components_coupled.statement: Every residual Y0 component C in the post-seed-two final state has D_C nonempty.
proof: The current seed S is nonempty after seed-two.
Axiom (iii): every residual Y0 vertex is anticomplete to S.
If a component C of G[Y0] had no neighbor outside Y0 union X0, then C would be a connected component of G\X0 disjoint from S, contradicting connectedness.
Thus some u outside Y0 union X0 has a neighbor in C; u cannot be in S, and axiom (iv)+connectedness makes u complete to C.
all_components_coupled.consequence: B1B1C0 coupled-component compilation covers every residual Y0 component in this Part-B state.
